name: stackmind
description: Install AI coding configs for Cursor, Claude Code, and other agents by stack

scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run doctor && npm run cli_smoke && npm run eval && npm run demo_proof
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run validate && npm run doctor && npm run cli_smoke && npm run eval
scripts.examples: node bin/stackmind.js init nextjs ./examples/nextjs_applied --force && node bin/stackmind.js init python ./examples/python_applied --force && node bin/stackmind.js init nestjs ./examples/nestjs_applied --force && node bin/stackmind.js init vue_nuxt ./examples/vue_nuxt_applied --force
